label: H.R. 10329
title: Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026
short_title: Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 741.

summary: Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026 This bill requires the Small Business Administration, in consultation with appropriate agencies, to develop and publish educational materials about foreign adversary conduct that poses material harm to small businesses. The educational materials must (1) describe the conduct that poses such harm, (2) identify best practices for small businesses to protect sensitive information and supply chains, and (3) provide guidance for cybersecurity and data protection.
